cohort: The study included 2203 women (1303 from the UK and 900 from the NL) who gave birth between January 2017 and December 2020 and completed the Babies Born Better survey.
finding: Respondents in the Netherlands were significantly more likely to report a positive childbirth experience compared to those in the UK (85% vs. 66%), with determinants for positive experiences largely linked to uncomplicated labor, multiparity, and fulfilled choices.
mod_finding: A spontaneous vaginal birth was a significant determinant for a positive childbirth experience, and UK respondents who had a planned caesarean section also reported a higher likelihood of a positive experience.
cross-section timing: Births occurring between January 2017 and December 2020
